name: Cleo Cragganmore
source:
A peerless sorceress within the game world, Cleo is also the party’s ruthless dictator.
Uninhibited and selfish with an acid tongue, it is her power that allowed the girls to come to the real world. She’s aggressive in bed and petite in build.
